title: `estimate` refuses instead of understating (R1005 slice 1)
body:
Slice 1 of `docs/plans/oracle/refuse-on-missing-artifact.md` — **OD-9 / R1005**, evidence **BL-7**.

`project` read a missing `data/index.jsonl` as **zero videos indexed**. That is the denominator of the one number the owner spends against, and the output was indistinguishable from a real empty corpus.

**New `src/find_best_mobo/artifacts.py`** holds the rule once. Its own module rather than part of `config.py`, because every stage imports it and a path check must not drag configuration into anything that only needs a path. `MissingArtifact` subclasses `FileNotFoundError` and is constructed the way the standard library constructs one, so `.errno` and `.filename` carry what every existing handler already reads — **no caller learns a new exception**.

**The forgiving branch is deleted, not moved.** `project`'s docstring paragraph that *argued for* the zero is replaced with R1005's reasoning.

**`estimate` checks all three upstream artifacts in pipeline order before it cuts anything**, so a refusal never leaves bundles on disk and the stage named is the earliest one that has not run. Told to run `select` first, the owner would run a stage that itself refuses.

**`fetch` now creates `data/transcripts/`** whether or not it caches anything, including when the run halts on an R24 trigger. Before this the directory appeared only on the first successful write, so "fetch never ran" and "fetch ran and everything failed" were **one state on disk** — the conflation R1005 forbids, and the state every downstream stage now reads as its precondition.

**Per-video tolerance is unchanged**, and that is the load-bearing negative: `_excerpts_for` still returns no excerpts for a selected video with no cached transcript, because a title hit needs no caption track (R2, R24). What changed is only the absence of the cache *itself*.

**Four existing tests gain one line** creating the empty cache directory a `fetch` run would have left. Each is about a state where fetch HAS run, so the line restores exactly what the test was always about; no assertion is weakened.

18 new tests, 536 passing.

Carries a merge of the base branch so the required checks run against the tree this will land on.
